ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Divide beef into 4 equal balls without overworking the meat.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking hot.
Place beef balls on the skillet and smash flat immediately using a heavy spatula for 10 seconds.
Season with salt and pepper, flip when edges are crispy, add cheese, and serve.

ingredients: 4 pkgs (8 oz each) cream cheese, softened
instructions: Mix graham crumbs and melted butter, press firmly into a springform pan.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Add vanilla, then add eggs one at a time just until blended.
Pour over crust and bake at 325°F (160°C) for 60 minutes until set.
